author: Home RenoVision DIY
description:
In this video, I show you how to measure, cut, stain, and install a solid hardwood stair tread, including how to avoid tear-out, get a tight fit, and apply the adhesive properly.
At roughly $100 per step, cost is only part of the decision. You also need to consider how much work is involved, the skill level required, and how many tools you’ll need to get a professional result.

Watch the full stair finish comparison to see how hardwood stacks up against vinyl, tile, veneer, and sanding and staining 👇🏼
